source.name: Laza 4chan Fuuka Archive
source.short-desc: This data was donated to the Bibliotheca Anonoma, which uploaded it to the Internet Archive for safekeeping on December 23th, 2015.

prepare.name: unpack any archived dump
prepare.run: mkdir -p extracted && for f in source/*.xz source/*.7z source/*.zip; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; case "$f" in *.tar.xz) tar xJf "$f" -C extracted;; *.xz) cp -a "$f" extracted/ && (cd extracted && unxz -f "$(basename "$f")");; *) 7z x -aos -o./extracted "$f";; esac; done; true

prepare.name: stage the Fuuka mysqldump for ingest
prepare.run: mkdir -p out && f=$(find source extracted -maxdepth 3 -name 'tables.sql' 2>/dev/null | head -1) && [ -n "$f" ] && (cp -al "$f" out/ 2>/dev/null || cp -a "$f" out/)
